summary: media list --all follows Graph paging.next, sending its after= cursor, instead of stopping after page 1 while reporting complete; a walk cut short by the page cap or a cursorless next link never reports complete.
reason: The generator dropped the spec's cursor_field and passed paging.next (a URL) as a boolean has_more_field, so --all silently returned only the first page and single-page reads never emitted the truncation hint.
validated_outcome: Two-page Graph fixture test drives the real media list command and fails on both the old call site and a helper without the URL-to-cursor reduction; a never-ending fixture stops at the 100-page cap with max_pages_cap_hit and no complete event; live --all on a ~1.9k-media business account returns every item at --limit 25 (75 pages) and 100 (19 pages), identical to a manual --after walk.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Regenerate once the generator reads a URL-valued has_more_field (Graph paging.next) as a next link (cli-printing-press#4836), or from a spec whose Graph list endpoints declare cursor_param: after, limit_param: limit, next_cursor_path: paging.next.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: #3801 only restores cursor_field; the spec's has_more_field: paging.next is a URL, not a boolean, and the generator template still reads it as a failed bool, so a regen from the current spec would still mis-wire the call site.
